ITEM 1 | Yellow grainy starch, bright saffron-yellow with orange flecks and small diced pieces, loosely mounded in the upper-left of the plate, soft and slightly moist with separate grains, covering about 20% of the plate footprint and roughly 1.5 cm tall | 110
ITEM 2 | Dark green wilted leafy greens, glossy and limp with some darker crinkled edges, piled in the upper-right area of the plate, covering about 20% of the plate footprint and about 2 cm tall, sitting partly over the pale vegetable beside it | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-white braised or steamed vegetable wedge with soft translucent layers, slightly glossy and moist, lying diagonally across the center-right of the plate, about 10 cm long and 3 cm wide, 1.5 cm tall | 70
ITEM 4 | Thin green string-like beans, bright to medium green with slight sheen, lined up diagonally across the lower right of the plate, about 12 cm long bundle roughly 2 cm wide and 0.8 cm tall | 45
ITEM 5 | Seared protein piece with golden-brown crusted surface, flecked with darker char and seasoning specks, moist pale interior edge visible, lying at the lower-left of the plate, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm thick | 130
